tabs.one: GTA 6 breaks global entertainment records with $3.79 billion in day-one sales, while global tech stocks face a brutal sell-off.
tabs.html:
The big stories

  • GTA 6 Record Launch: Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI shattered entertainment history by generating $3.79 billion in first-day sales, selling 32.5 million preorders.
  • Global Tech & AI Sell-Off: Nvidia shares plunged 14% amid a broader market correction, pushing Alphabet past Nvidia in market capitalization as investors scrutinize heavy AI infrastructure spending and debt funding.
  • AI Breakthrough Claims: An Anthropic researcher claimed a Claude-assisted proof for the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis in Lean, though the unverified claim parallels a separate human-written proof from Stanford.
  • Apple & Samsung Exec Moves: Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent capable of coding and operating apps via multi-step tasks, while Samsung appointed Won-Joon Choi as the new head of its Mobile Experience (MX) division, keeping TM Roh as CEO.
  • Big Tech Regulatory Pressure: YouTube has reportedly agreed in principle to pay $3 billion to settle school district claims over addictive design harming children.

Launches & products

  • Huawei OSTA O1 Pro: Huawei launched its new "Osta" accessible smart technology sub-brand in China, featuring a 200MP camera and a 7,000mAh battery.
  • Logitech MX Master 4 Creator Edition: Launched in India with a studio-inspired design, customisable controls, and haptic feedback.
  • Nothing AI Device: Nothing confirmed a December 8 unveiling for its first dedicated, screen-less AI-native hardware device.
  • Motorola Razr Flex: Official-looking renders surfaced for Motorola's upcoming wide foldable in "Dark Botanical Garden" and "Coriander" finishes.

The market angle

  • Samsung (NSE: GALAXY / KRX: 005930): Samsung is reportedly building advanced HBM4E memory chips for Meta's AI systems, alongside internal leadership changes in its mobile unit.
  • Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL): Apple has started selling individual iPhone Duo repair parts in select Western regions (with inner displays at $499), highlighting stark repair cost gaps with markets like India where out-of-warranty replacements touch ₹1,49,900.
  • Take-Two Interactive (NASDAQ: TTWO): Parent company Take-Two reaped the rewards of GTA 6's historic $3.79 billion opening day, which also drove a temporary spike in workplace time-off requests.
  • Bending Spoons: Acquired email marketing platform Mailchimp from Intuit for $3.68 billion, a steep discount from its 2021 acquisition price.

Worth reading

  • Anthropic’s Math Claim: 48 – An inside look at how AI assistants are being leveraged to tackle centuries-old mathematical mysteries.
  • Sarvam AI's Warning: 126 – A timely critique from Sarvam's co-founder cautioning India against over-dependence on foreign foundational AI platforms.
  • Data Center Energy Solutions: 121 – Explores how super-hot rock geothermal energy startups aim to solve the escalating power crisis facing AI data centers.
